reading_issues: Filename says 2024-02-15 but the chart header date is 14/02/2024 (13:15); the header date is used. Hardness bars and boundaries (24, 55, 96, 121, 134, 135, 148 cm) measured from pixels; at 3.7 px/cm boundaries are good to about 0.3 cm and were rounded to whole cm. The grain-form/size/moisture table is blank for every layer, so all grain fields are null; only the layer note 'Feb 3rd' (134-135 cm, K-hard) gives a layer identity (likely a crust, type not stated). CT23 PC at 135 cm sits at the top of that thin K layer (layer_grain left null); 'x2' is non-bold free text, count 2. Elevation, coordinates, aspect, slope and air temperature are as printed in the header.
